scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-docs dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-basic dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-i18n dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-search dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-search-i18n dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-typecheck dev:prepare
scripts.benchmark:search: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-i18n build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-search.mjs
scripts.example: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const target = process.argv[1]; if (!target) { console.error('Usage: pnpm example <group>/<name>'); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync('pnpm', ['--dir', `examples/${target}`, 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:repo-policies && pnpm run check:compatibility-matrix && pnpm run check:test-selection && pnpm run api-docs:check && eslint .
scripts.pack:check: pnpm build:packages && (cd packages/content && npm pack --dry-run --json) && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm --dir packages/content pack --pack-destination "$tmpdir" && tar -tzf "$tmpdir"/lupinum-ginko-content-*.tgz >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmpdir"
scripts.release:verify: node scripts/timed-command.mjs compatibility:check pnpm compatibility:check && node scripts/timed-command.mjs docs-drift pnpm docs-drift && node scripts/timed-command.mjs verify pnpm verify && node scripts/timed-command.mjs browser-e2e pnpm test:e2e:browser && node scripts/timed-command.mjs generate pnpm test:generate:static && node scripts/timed-command.mjs audit:prod pnpm audit:prod && node scripts/timed-command.mjs release:pack pnpm release:pack && node scripts/timed-command.mjs pure-runtimes pnpm test:pure-runtimes && node scripts/timed-command.mjs consumer:pnpm pnpm test:package-consumer && node scripts/timed-command.mjs consumer:npm pnpm test:package-consumer:npm
scripts.release:publish: node -e "console.error('Direct publish scripts are disabled. Run release:verify and release:pack, inspect .pack, then follow MAINTAINING.md.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:coverage: vitest --coverage --project unit --project provider --project contracts-node --project runtime --project client --project nuxt
scripts.test:golden: pnpm build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project contracts-node test/contracts/vnext-golden-demo.test.ts
scripts.test:compatibility-slice: pnpm release:pack && pnpm test:package-consumer && pnpm test:generate:static && pnpm test:search:matrix
scripts.test:minimum-runtime: pnpm test && pnpm test:quickstart && node scripts/pr-e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:quickstart: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-quickstart dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-quickstart typecheck && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-quickstart build
scripts.test:search:matrix: pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project e2e test/e2e/search-matrix.test.ts
scripts.test:sitemap:static: pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project e2e test/e2e/sitemap-static.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:source && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-typecheck typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project provider --project contracts-node --project runtime --project client --project nuxt
scripts.test:watch: vitest watch --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project provider --project contracts-node --project runtime --project client --project nuxt
scripts.verify: pnpm dev:prepare && pnpm lint && pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:smoke && pnpm examples:build && pnpm typecheck:examples && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:quickstart
